In this study, a small amount of Nbss/Nb5Si3 interface decohesion is seen in annealed Nb–17Si–10Mo–0.1Ga alloy (Fig. 5(b)).

It implies that when interface toughness is less than a quarter of Nbss toughness, interface decohesion would occur. So either reducing interface toughness or enhancing Nbss toughness is advantageous for interface decohesion.
